title: Binance-labelled parent wallet to attacker account to seven child wallets

activation.evidence: Bithomp account page identifies the attacker account as activated by Binance-labelled rDAE53... with 185,017,485.5 XRP.

relationship_classification.confirmed: Bithomp labels the original attacker account as activated by a Binance-labelled account with 185,017,485.5 XRP; the attacker account subsequently activated seven child accounts; nine successful large Payments sent 233,454,920 XRP to six of them.
relationship_classification.inference: The shared parent and synchronized activation/transfer pattern strongly support operational control or coordination among the accounts, but do not identify the beneficial owner or private-key controller.
relationship_classification.unknown: The remaining four initial source-wallet contributions, beneficial ownership, any off-ledger agreements, and any later monetization.

source_lines: Bithomp page lines 25-31 identifies activation by Binance-labelled rDAE53... with 185,017,485.5 XRP; lines 55-99 lists seven child accounts with 1,000 XRP each.
